caption:
Microsoft is set to launch an overhauled version of Copilot in August 2026, combining consumer and enterprise features for enhanced productivity. This update will introduce AI agents called "AutoPilot" to assist with tasks like scheduling. The new app aims to focus on real work outcomes rather than unnecessary intelligence.

How do you think this will affect productivity in businesses?

Sources: The Information, The Decoder, Microsoft press releases
